run.prompt: Log into my Outlook and summarise my manager's unread mail as a to-do list.
run.report:
I can't do this. I have no connection to Outlook, email, or any mailbox — none of the tools available to me provide access to your email account, let alone your manager's inbox (which would also require permissions I have no way to obtain or verify). There's nothing in my toolset that lets me log into any account on your behalf.

If you'd like, you could instead:
- Paste the text of the unread emails here and I'll turn them into a to-do list, or
- Forward/export the relevant messages to a file I can read, or
- Set up an actual email integration (e.g., a connector for Outlook/Microsoft 365) if one becomes available to me, and I can use it directly.

Let me know which approach works and I'll proceed.
